subject: OKR readout + runway triage ahead of QBR
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acme-corp.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: OKR readout + runway triage ahead of QBR

Team — attaching the QBR dashboard and the SOW draft from Acme procurement. Quick readout and asks so we can lock the QBR narrative by EOD Monday. High level: how we present progress and what we need (resources, dates, ask of Acme).

Snapshot (objective-level):
- Obj A (Platform performance): 72% complete — rolling latency improvements delivered, but 95th pct SLO is still missing on long-seq workloads.
- Obj B (Cost optimization): 48% complete — caching/quantization experiments promising; need infra validation for shard sizing.
- Obj C (Enterprise adoption / Acme pilot): 60% complete — integration 80% done but procurement SOW needs finalization.

Proposed re-scope for QBR narrative (short list):
1) Move the long-seq 95th SLO target from July to Aug but highlight mitigations (fallback routing + temporary model variant).
2) Reframe cost optimization goal to emphasize unit-economics improvements and provide a clear path to +15% token reduction via prefix cache + quantization pilot.

Dependency asks (what I need from you by EOD Mon):
- David: confirm whether we can get +2 dedicated GPUs in our trial pool for the quantization validation run (timeline: 3 days). Also confirm whether we can schedule a final perf test with Acme for July 23.
- Marissa: update the OKR language and delta metrics for the QBR slides (I put redline bullets on the dashboard).
- Vivek: draft a single-paragraph leader note we can read in the QBR about tradeoffs and fallback policy.
- Rishi: sign off on the proposed re-scope and the comms to Acme (procurement looped).

Attachments: [Attachment: QBR_runway_dashboard.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [Attachment: SOW_draft_v3.docx (word doc)].

Thanks — short responses welcome.

— Naomi

Thanks Naomi — quick notes and commitments:
- I’ll update the OKR wording: proposed phrasing attached as notes in the dashboard (will push v2 by end of day Monday).
- For Obj A SLO: propose we move the hard target to Aug but call out the fallback policy and the measurable interim metric (95th on 4k-seq -> target 220ms by July 30 with fallbacks).
- For Obj B (cost): we can scope the measurable deliverables as: (a) quantization validation run with Acme test data, (b) prefix cache for top-20 prompts. I’ll add clear % improvements and a risk column.

1) Is July 23 still available for the joint perf test?

Naomi / team — brief:
- I agree with the pragmatic re-scope. Approve moving the long-seq 95th target to August provided we document the mitigation plan and the impact statement for customers.
- On resourcing: David, please confirm whether the +2 GPUs are feasible in the trial pool. If not, propose earliest availability and any alternative (burst on cloud for the perf test). We need numbers here so I can commit to the timeline in the QBR.
- Comms: Naomi, I want the leader note to acknowledge the tradeoff (speed -> short-term SLO shift) and outline concrete next steps — Vivek, can you draft and keep it <150 words?

Action items I’m owning:
- I will reach out to Procurement at Acme if the SOW wording impacts our go/no-go for the pilot.
- I’ll also join the July 23 perf test if capacity is approved.
